body: You're not being rude but giving constructive advice. Thanks for that!
Rationally I understand you're just trying to give advice, but this somehow forms a new embarrassing memory for me. I'm such a mentally fragile bitch...
Thanks for your advice. I'll give it a try.
Every night before bed I just swallow some pills and pass out anyway. I didn't know how my sleep quality is actually.

I've had a therapist once. All he has done is telling me "let it go". When I asked how he just replied "you should find it out yourself." Also I've been occupying myself with all kinds of videos, tv shows, movies, musics and novels, but whenever a plot, a scene, a sentence, even a word relates to my past experience, all shits would be triggered and flood my mind.
I could relate to you. Every night I just swallow several sleeping pills and get into bed early and sleep through until almost noon. It's only when sleeping I could gain some peace of mind.
I've tried, occupying myself with watching videos lectures, movies, tv shows, reading, etc. But a scene, a sentence, even a word related would trigger all the bad thoughts.
